method.space: linear sRGB from 16-bit sRGB encoding, full definition
method.detail: RMS of Y - G1, G1 - G2, G2 - G4 on the most structured tiles
method.noise: Haar HH and mid band (G1 - G4) MAD sigma of luminance on the flattest tiles
method.overshoot: RMS of the luminance beyond the neutral's 3 x 3 local range, over its mean range
method.factor: median per-tile ratio state / own neutral, tiles chosen on each engine's neutral
method.unmatched: IPR has no detail control: every Lightroom detail value is compared with the same IPR render
